On Friday 11/13/2026 the 2026 Bogleheads Conference kicks off. While I am not able to attend in person I know I will be watching for the posting of the YouTube videos of the conference speakers under the Resources tab on the Bogle Center website. The video postings from the conference usually begin a few weeks after the conference concludes and then are posted periodically until they have all been posted. Past presentations prior years are also available at the Bogle Center website.
Here is a link to the 2026 agenda.
Adam Grossman who posts an informative article every Saturday on Humble Dollar will be one of the 2026 speakers at the conference. I also recognize a number of presenter names who have from time to time posted a comment on HD.
I have also read one or multiple books written by six of the seven presenters pictured in the above link and feel I am a better investor for doing so. I hope you have the same experience.
